I want to add one of my personal favorites that people always seem to find exotic and hard to cook, but it's actually really easy.

  1. Debone a full chicken and dice up the meat, or you can just use the leg/thigh/wing. You can also buy a pack of wings/legs/thighs

  2. Cook chicken in a pan with nothing else but the chicken, make sure to throughly brown both sides until it leaves some on the bottom of the pan. If you don't brown, it leaves out a ton of flavor. Medium high/High heat

  3. After browning, add 1 cup of vinegar and stir the chicken around gently to remove bits on the bottom of the pan.

  4. Add 3/4 cup of soy sauce or 1 cup, and 2 tablespoons of butter

  5. Cover with lid and turn the heat down so it simmers.

  6. Serve when chicken is brown and most of the strong vinegar aroma has left the pan. You can check this by lifting the lid and smelling, if you want to cough after smelling it, it usually has too much vinegar left although it won't affect the end flavor much it can be a turn off for some people.

Seriously one of the easiest things to make, yet people suck it up like it's an exotic meal.
